It is really inspiring to see the great work that the @ModelAllianceNY is doing. Thank you to the brave individuals who've spoken out against @VictoriasSecret in an attempt to end sexual harassment in the fashion industry. #TimesUp #MeToo
https://t.co/9IIDCVsdj7

"#MeToo is about how people relate to people who have experienced something you have not." Emma Holten 🔥🔥🔥 Thank you for lifting up the "hysterical", the changemakers & those who courageously speak out even when the world wants them/us to be silent. #MeTooReykjavik https://t.co/KwSqEsCvvq

'Solidarity and struggle do eventually make change.' Angela Davis

The #MeToo Movement is an extraordinary proof of this. #MeTooReykjavik https://t.co/kP6Pvr86Z6
On the 2 year #MeToo anniversary, a reminder that farmworker women and domestic workers have been organizing to make their workplaces safer for generations. https://t.co/RGwDy3jwVx

On the 2nd anniversary of #MeToo, debate moderators missed a huge opportunity to ask about one of the most pressing safety & health issues impacting millions of people. Sign this petition to ask @msnbc & @washingtonpost to raise #MeToo on Nov. 20th: https://t.co/xD4rVwdtHm

Thank you @jaclynf & @JessicaValenti for giving us the opportunity to be part of your project & to have the chance to share some of our thoughts, solutions & perspectives in the wake of #MeToo & #TimesUp movement break throughs.

We're not letting political leaders off the hook. They must step up for the thousands of ppl who've said #MeToo. I am talking about this TOMORROW, 10/29, at the @CareInActionUSA event, alongside @JessLivMo @KathyKLTran & #MalenaLlanos. VA folks, join us! https://t.co/55CUhhEs9i

.@LGJustinFairfax, your conduct & speech threatens to chill the ability of victims to come forward. As the 2nd most powerful person in VA & a political leader, remember that you are accountable to the survivors in your state & beyond who have bravely broken their silence. #MeToo
